CHANGELOG updated in DEADWEIGHT: Fix: redeem-code input buffer was 23 chars, truncating every real 29-char claim code before it was sent -- unlocking Premium/redeeming codes never worked. Also fixed stale ticket-balance display (to_menu never refreshed it) and a hardcoded hub_active=1 bug that ignored the server's real draft-run state after a run ended. (sess-20260920-1908-24cb3558)

⚓ ☃
